assumptions: The Stripe webhook is configured with the payment_intent.succeeded event and includes the customer object.
The Mailchimp audience already exists and accepts tags on subscriber records.
The plan identifier from Stripe can be used directly as a tag name in Mailchimp (or will be transformed to a valid tag format).

sources.title: Receive Stripe events in your webhook endpoint | Stripe Documentation
Add or remove member tags | Mailchimp | Developer
Import and export contacts | Mailchimp | Developer

source.url: (webhook endpoint URL provided by the connector user)
notes: Stripe sends webhook events as POST requests with JSON payload. The connector must verify the Stripe-Signature header using the webhook signing secret (whsec_).
The payment_intent.succeeded event includes a customer object with email and subscription fields. The subscription object contains a plan with an id field.
Return a 2xx status quickly to avoid retries; do not perform long-running operations before responding.
Requires list_id and subscriber_hash (MD5 hash of lowercase email address) as path parameters.
The tags array is required; each tag object requires a name and optional status (defaults to active).
To upsert a member first, use PUT to /3.0/lists/{list_id}/members/{subscriber_hash} with email_address and status_if_new before adding tags.
No pagination; this is a single call per member.
